claims.description: Hooke published his elasticity law in 1676 as the anagram ceiiinosssttuu, claiming priority without disclosure while he pursued a watch patent. He unsealed it in 1678 as ut tensio, sic vis, meaning: as the extension, so the force.
claims.name: Ut tensio, sic vis
